state: Price DOWN + CVD FLAT/SLIGHTLY UP + OI DOWN after failed value reclaim
interpretation: The failed-reclaim short edge has already expressed itself: price moved lower after failing value, while OI contracted sharply from ~18.61B to ~18.32B and long liquidations increased. CVD did not deteriorate much and is slightly higher, which means the current downswing is now dominated more by position closure/deleveraging than by a clean fresh bearish leverage expansion. This makes a new market short materially less attractive than the earlier failed-reclaim entry.

short_scenario.preferred_reentry: Bounce into ~77.14k dVAL or ~77.215k dOpen followed by rejection/lower high while CVD stalls/rolls and OI remains elevated or rebuilds.
short_scenario.continuation_trigger: Break below ~76.825k dBL / ~76.6k low cluster is higher-quality only if Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI FLAT/UP appears, showing fresh directional leverage rather than another forced deleveraging leg.
short_scenario.avoid: If price breaks lower while OI is collapsing again, avoid chasing the short into another liquidation low.

long_scenario.first_condition: Hold the ~76.825k dBL / ~76.6k low cluster without fresh price/CVD lows and with OI stabilizing.
long_scenario.first_trigger: Reclaim ~77.14k dVAL and hold/retest above it.
long_scenario.stronger_trigger: Reclaim ~77.215k dOpen and then ~77.355k dPOC with positive price response to CVD/OI.
long_scenario.invalidation: Fresh loss of the lower balance while CVD turns down and OI starts rebuilding upward during the decline.

edge_lesson: The best short was the failed structural repair, not the later downside extension. Once rejection has already produced lower price and OI starts collapsing, the expected quality of a new short deteriorates. Edge timing must distinguish SIGNAL GENERATION (failed reclaim with crowded leverage) from PAYOFF/DELEVERAGING (OI collapse after the move is already underway).
